step1_analysis.description: A charge pump circuit for a Phase-Locked Loop (PLL). It converts differential UP and DOWN phase error signals from a Phase Frequency Detector (PFD) into an output current (sourcing or sinking) to drive a loop filter.

paper_reference.title: A 0.18-m CMOS Offset-PLL Upconversion Modulation Loop IC for DCS1800 Transmitter

I_up.description: Charge pump sourcing current when the UP signal is active.

sky130_expected.calculation: Depends on the effective tail current and current mirror ratios. With W=5u and L=0.5u, typical charge pump currents are in the tens to hundreds of microamps.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard charge pump currents for integrated PLLs in the 1-2 GHz range to maintain reasonable loop filter capacitor sizes.

I_dw.description: Charge pump sinking current when the DOWN signal is active.

sky130_expected.calculation: Should closely match the magnitude of I_up to minimize reference spurs.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Sinking current mirrors the sourcing current magnitude. Mismatch leads to phase offset and spurs.

Power.description: Average power consumption of the charge pump circuit.

sky130_expected.calculation: I_avg * VDD. If Icp is 50uA, the total bias and switching current might be ~150uA. 150uA * 1.8V = 270uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The charge pump consumes a small fraction of the total 36mA IC current, mostly dominated by the VCO and dividers.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to measure the UP (sourcing) and DOWN (sinking) currents of the charge pump by applying sequential pulses to the differential UP/UPB and DW/DWB inputs, while holding the output at VDD/2.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Charge Pump Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u
.param W_xm11=5u L_xm11=0.5u
.param W_xm12=5u L_xm12=0.5u
.param W_xm13=5u L_xm13=0.5u
.param W_xm14=5u L_xm14=0.5u
.param W_xm15=5u L_xm15=0.5u

XM1 N2 DWB DW GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N6 N6 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 DW GND GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N5 N5 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 FROM_PUMP2 FROM_PUMP2 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 PLLOUT FROM_PUMP2 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N5 UPB N7 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N6 UP N7 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 N7 GND GND UPB sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 N4 N4 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}
XM11 FROM_PUMP2 N4 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm11} w={W_xm11}
XM12 GND GND GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm12} w={W_xm12}
XM13 N2 N2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm13} w={W_xm13}
XM14 N4 DW N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm14} w={W_xm14}
XM15 PLLOUT N6 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm15} w={W_xm15}

* Power Supply and Output Bias
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VPLLOUT PLLOUT 0 0.9

* Input Stimulus (UP active 5n-15n, DW active 25n-35n)
VUP UP 0 pulse(0 1.8 5n 100p 100p 10n 40n)
VUPB UPB 0 pulse(1.8 0 5n 100p 100p 10n 40n)
VDW DW 0 pulse(0 1.8 25n 100p 100p 10n 40n)
VDWB DWB 0 pulse(1.8 0 25n 100p 100p 10n 40n)

.control
tran 100p 50n

* Measure UP current (sourcing, flows into VPLLOUT source)
meas tran i_up avg i(VPLLOUT) from=6n to=14n

* Measure DOWN current (sinking, flows out of VPLLOUT source)
meas tran i_dw avg i(VPLLOUT) from=26n to=34n

* Measure Average Power
let pwr = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
meas tran avg_pwr avg pwr from=0 to=50n

print i_up i_dw avg_pwr
quit
.endc
